name: Drum and bass
description: A drum and bass track for DJs: a long intro, two drops around a breakdown, and a long outro. 160 bars.

sections.name: Intro
sections.tip: Drums and atmosphere, simple enough for a DJ to mix in. Tease the bass.

sections.name: Build-up
sections.tip: Risers, snare rolls and a filter opening up.

sections.name: Drop
sections.tip: The full breakbeat and the main bass.

sections.name: Breakdown
sections.tip: Pads, a vocal or a melody, with the drums out or quiet.

sections.name: Build-up
sections.tip: Build again, bigger than the first time.

sections.name: Drop
sections.tip: The second drop: change the bass or the drums so it isn't a copy of the first.

sections.name: Outro
sections.tip: Back to the drums and a few parts, for a DJ to mix out.
